summary: The handover check scopes each app exactly and attributes every relation to the producer that draws it. Probed across all configs/prd apps on the live set and the P2 snapshot: no element is claimed twice, and there are 0 relation misattributions against HelmCharts' render. The 11 fixture tests are real and pass. One advisory: an in-house exposed interface that nothing links is in no app's scope.

findings.summary: An in-house exposed interface that no instance links (all 17 on the live set before HelmCharts publishes; any B2-class Service later) is in no app's scope, so losing it passes the check silently
